## Learning Objectives
- Review random variables, expected value, and variance
- Understand how to evaluate estimators based on bias and variance
- Estimate the population mean and total with SRS
- Estimate the variance of estimators with SRS
- Design a stratified random sample
- Idenitify when a stratified random sample may be preferable to an SRS
:::

For additional practice problems and reading see:

- Ch 2.1-2.2, 3.1 in [Sampling: Design and Analysis 3rd Edition](https://csu-calpoly.primo.exlibrisgroup.com/discovery/fulldisplay?docid=cdi_globaltitleindex_catalog_336273757&context=PC&vid=01CALS_PSU:01CALS_PSU&lang=en&search_scope=Everything&adaptor=Primo%20Central&tab=Everything&query=any,contains,sampling%20design%20and%20analysis&offset=0) by Sharon L.
